verdict.rationale: Aider is a terminal chat tool, not an in-IDE chat panel. Its documented `--watch-files` mode lets you stay in your own IDE or editor and trigger it with comments: `AI?` makes it answer a question and `AI!` makes it edit code, which a community user corroborates. That gives comment-driven contextual help inside the editor, but no conversational chat interface within the IDE itself. Missing for 10: a native IDE extension or chat panel, real-time conversational chat inside the editor, and hands-on evidence of the IDE experience beyond watch-mode comments.
